name: glass-button
title: Glass Button
description: Liquid Glass buttons and toolbars. GlassButton: label, icon or both in three sizes (icon-only is a circle), plain monochrome glass or tinted glass for the primary action, a spring press and a light haptic — real interactive Liquid Glass on iOS 26, blur everywhere else. GlassToolbar: icon buttons in one glass capsule with hairline separators, or a floating cluster of glass circles that melt into each other on iOS 26, with an active state for tools and toggles.
